claim_ceiling: Preparation of one observable-semantics reconciliation only. No calculation, canonical-semantics selection, H_A-H_E result, simulation, robustness reclassification, materiality result, or new E-REPRO is authorized.

decision_rule_after_calculation.PREDICATE_INVARIANT: all dominant blocks, event ordering, criterion statuses, hypothesis statuses, supported-mechanism sets, and aggregate candidates agree; a later independent review may select explicit canonical derived semantics
decision_rule_after_calculation.PREDICATE_SENSITIVE: record BLOCKED_OBSERVABLE_DECISION_INSTABILITY, keep H_A-H_E unevaluated, and close the R13 mechanism lane

frozen_observable_definition.exact_comparison_rule: binary64 bit identity plus recorded ULP distance
frozen_observable_definition.finite_domain: all eight inputs finite and nonnegative
frozen_observable_definition.input_derivation: max(abs(packed defect block)) / max(role tolerance, gamma64)
frozen_observable_definition.serialization_rule: canonical UTF-8 JSON, sorted keys, shortest round-trip finite decimal
frozen_observable_definition.signed_zero_rule: negative zero is rejected; raw absolute-max derivation supplies positive zero
frozen_observable_definition.tie_rule: numpy argmax; first maximum in the frozen block order wins
frozen_observable_definition.zero_denominator_rule: gamma64 makes the all-zero denominator strictly positive

historical_semantics.historical_status: used to create cached payload shares
historical_semantics.reduction: np.sum(np.stack(float64 scalar arrays in frozen block order), axis=0)[0]

historical_semantics.historical_status: used by frozen v3 raw-evidence verifier
historical_semantics.reduction: Python built-in sum over eight float values in frozen block order
